0001_knowledge.sql.reason: Creates isolated knowledge tables in a separate database; no personnel data or rules changed.

0002_production_catalog.sql.reason: Adds publication, issue revisions, named reception, revocable read grants and attachments in the independent database; preserves all legacy knowledge records.

0003_knowledge_workspace.sql.reason: Adds independent document branches, immutable commits, three-member consent, explicit multi-candidate selection, issues and anchored comments; preserves legacy records and private draft ownership.

0004_reviews_and_categories.sql.reason: Adds single-document review provenance, automatic three-member promotion for new reviews, independent category definitions and annotation issue sources; preserves existing branches, comments and legacy merge behavior.
